$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：太陰獨坐辰戌，《深造講義》p.76。

basis.quote: 属于盲动，抑或具有目标

rules.text: 你的太陰在辰，對宮的太陽在戌已落陷，比在戌宮的太陰暗晦一些。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin sits in Chen, facing a Sun already fallen in Xu, so it's a little dimmer than a Tai Yin in Xu.

source.quote: 因而辰宫的太阴亦较戌宫者为暗晦

rules.text: 你的太陰在戌，與辰宮的太陽相對，古人稱為日月拱照，本質良好。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin sits in Xu facing the Sun in Chen, what the ancients called sun and moon shining on each other: a good foundation.

rules.text: 盲動的一面較重：在困局裡愈掙扎，愈被纏住；先定好目標再動，比急著衝出去好。
rules.en: The aimless side is stronger: the more you struggle in a tight spot, the more tangled you get; set a goal before you move, rather than rushing out.

source.quote: 但盲动者则愈挣扎愈受缠缚

rules.text: 有目標的一面較重：遇到困局，你能一舉破網而出，像游魚脫網。
rules.en: The purposeful side is stronger: in a tight spot you break out in one move, like a fish slipping the net.

rules.text: 你的命宮有屬金或屬火的星，早年較不順。
rules.en: Your Life Palace holds a star of the metal or fire element, so your early years are less smooth.
rules.edit: 原句另有「尤主不利父母」，六親斷語不入命宮讀者句。

also.quote: 属金的星曜：文昌、擎羊、陀罗
